title: Advance Return Election Mileage Credit — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Maturity Notice
content:
**Notice to Kestrel Advantage Balloon customers.** On a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a customer who records the election to return the vehicle well ahead of the maturity date has miles forgiven on the excess mileage charge. The lead time is measured from the date of the most recent maturity election recorded as a vehicle return to the maturity date:

| Most recent return election recorded | Miles forgiven |
|---|---|
| At least 30 calendar days before the maturity date | 300 |
| At least 15 but fewer than 30 calendar days before the maturity date | 150 |
| Fewer than 15 calendar days before the maturity date, on or after it, or no return election recorded | None |

Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one: an election recorded on the 1st of a month for a maturity date on the 31st of that month is recorded 30 calendar days before it.

## Hypothetical cases (maturity on the 31st of a month)

| Return election recorded | Lead | Miles forgiven |
|---|---|---|
| The 1st of that month | 30 days | 300 |
| The 2nd of that month | 29 days | 150 |
| The 16th of that month | 15 days | 150 |
| The 17th of that month | 14 days | None |

Only the most recent election recorded as a vehicle return is measured; an earlier return election does not count once a later one is on file.
